rules.position: AgentCo (and any third-party AI provider it uses) may not train, build, or enhance AI/ML on LargeCo candidate data, prompts, or outputs for any reason.
rules.quote: LargeCo cannot approve terms that allow AgentCo to train on, sell, share, or use candidate data outside the TalentFlow service.

rules.position: Provider warrants it will not use or process LargeCo data to train/build/enhance AI/ML, and must contractually bind third parties to the same restriction.
rules.quote: Provider represents and warrants that it shall and shall contractually obligate third parties to, not use or process LargeCo data to train, build, or enhance artificial intelligence or machine learning for any reason and such use case is expressly prohibited by this Agreement.

rules.position: Candidate materials, prompts, notes, scorecards, job requirements, configurations, and customer-specific outputs remain LargeCo-controlled information (owned by LargeCo, not AgentCo).
rules.quote: Candidate materials, prompts, notes, scorecards, job requirements, conﬁgurations, and customer-speciﬁc outputs should remain LargeCo-controlled information.

rules.topic: Decision-support only / no autonomous employment decisions
rules.position: TalentFlow must remain decision-support: it cannot autonomously rank, score, advance, reject, recommend, or make hire/reject/compensation/promotion/termination decisions without separate approval.
rules.quote: TalentFlow must remain a decision-support tool: it should not automatically rank, score, advance, reject, recommend, or make employment decisions without separate approval.

rules.position: TalentFlow may support human-reviewed hiring workflows but must not make autonomous hire, reject, compensation, promotion, termination, ranking, filtering, or scoring decisions.
rules.quote: TalentFlow may support human-reviewed hiring workﬂows, but it will not make autonomous hire, reject, compensation, promotion, termination, ranking, ﬁltering, or scoring decisions.

rules.topic: Scope limited to two approved use cases
rules.position: Pilot is limited to candidate-material summaries and interview-note drafting; any expansion (ATS/HRIS integration, automated screening, scoring, assessments, background checks, payroll, benefits, sensitive HR data) requires separate written approval, security review, and a scoped order form.
rules.fallback: Expansion can proceed under a new scoped order form with security review, not as an amendment to the pilot scope itself.
rules.quote: Any expansion into ATS/HRIS integrations, automated screening, candidate scoring, assessments, background checks, payroll, beneﬁts, or sensitive HR data should require separate written approval, security review, and a scoped order form.

rules.position: AgentCo must commit to disclosing third-party AI providers, subprocessors, data flows, logging practices, retention periods, deletion, export rights, and breach notice; must identify who can access candidate data and whether any third-party AI provider can retain or review LargeCo content.
rules.quote: LargeCo needs clear commitments on third-party AI providers, subprocessors, data ﬂows, logging, retention, deletion, export rights, and breach notice.

rules.position: Require encryption, SSO, role-based access, audit logs, least-privilege access, annual security evidence, incident response, and prompt notice of security events.
rules.quote: LargeCo should require encryption, SSO, role-based access, audit logs, least-privilege access, annual security evidence, incident response, and prompt notice of security events.

rules.topic: Broader operational controls out of scope for this pilot
rules.position: Source-code review, monthly scans, background checks, equipment approval, and facility access are appropriate only for future integrations or privileged access to LargeCo systems -- not for this SaaS pilot with no direct LargeCo system access. LargeCo should be willing to narrow or drop MSA-template provisions of this kind for this deal.
rules.fallback: Retain the right to require these controls if the engagement later expands into privileged system access, but don't insist on them now.
rules.quote: Broader controls like source-code review, monthly scans, background checks, equipment approval, or facility access should be reserved for future integrations or privileged access to LargeCo systems.

rules.position: Preserve clear pilot pricing, renewal terms, expansion mechanics, implementation milestones, invoicing rules, and the right to withhold disputed amounts.
rules.quote: LargeCo should preserve clear pilot pricing, renewal terms, expansion mechanics, implementation milestones, invoicing rules, and the right to withhold disputed amounts.

rules.position: A standard liability cap is acceptable for ordinary service issues, but LargeCo needs stronger remedies (higher cap or uncapped carve-out) for confidentiality, candidate-data security, privacy, no-training breaches, and misuse of candidate data.
rules.fallback: Accept a fees-based cap for general liability if paired with an enhanced cap/carve-out for the listed categories.
rules.quote: A standard liability cap may be acceptable for ordinary service issues, but LargeCo should seek stronger remedies for conﬁdentiality, candidate-data security, privacy, no-training breaches, and misuse of candidate data.

rules.topic: Deal context - scope should track actual use case
rules.position: AgentCo has flagged that LargeCo's template assumes risks outside this deal's actual scope (payment card data, consumer tracking tech, direct production-system access, bespoke operational controls); LargeCo can accept narrowing of clauses addressing risks genuinely absent from this pilot.
rules.fallback: Narrow rather than delete outright -- preserve the right to reinstate if scope expands under R-04.
rules.quote: concerned that LargeCo’s template assumes risks outside the initial use case, such as payment card data, consumer tracking technology, direct production-system access, and bespoke operational controls.

rules.position: Any Agent or subprocessor with access to LargeCo Confidential Information must be bound by a written agreement at least as restrictive as this Agreement, and AgentCo remains fully responsible for their performance.
rules.quote: Provider represents and warrants to LargeCo that Provider has entered into a fully-executed written agreement with each such Agent that imposes obligations on such Agent that are at least as restrictive on such Agent and at least as protective of LargeCo as those imposed on or required of Provider under this Agreement

rules.position: If Provider uses third-party AI technology, Provider remains fully responsible for its performance/compliance, must have an enterprise agreement with the AI licensor at least as restrictive as this Agreement, and must give 30 days' notice of material changes in AI Technology use.
rules.quote: Provider shall: (a) not be relieved of any of its obligations under this Agreement; (b) remain responsible to LargeCo for any and all performance of such AI Technology and compliance with the terms of this Agreement; (c) maintain an enterprise-level written agreement with the licensor of such AI Technology that imposes obligations that are at least as restrictive as those imposed on or required of Provider under this Agreement; (d) provide at least thirty (30) days’ written notice and opportunity for LargeCo to object to any planned material changes in the use of AI Technology

rules.position: LargeCo retains all rights in AI Inputs and owns all AI Outputs; both are LargeCo Confidential Information and IP, and Provider cannot commingle them with third-party data or use them outside the scope of the Services.
rules.quote: LargeCo retains all rights in and to AI Inputs and will be the owner of all AI Outputs. All AI Inputs and AI Outputs shall be LargeCo’s Intellectual Property and Confidential Information.

rules.position: Provider must notify LargeCo promptly of any suspected breach or unauthorized access/use/disclosure of LargeCo Confidential Information.
rules.fallback: Specific hour-based deadlines (e.g., 8/24 hours) are the template default and can be a negotiated fallback rather than a walk-away if AgentCo proposes a slightly longer but still prompt window.
rules.quote: Provider shall notify LargeCo via the email address provided below (as may be updated by LargeCo from time to time) of: (a) any access, possession, use or disclosure of LargeCo’s Confidential Information, or attempt thereof, not expressly permitted by this Agreement
